title: HashKey Exchange launches ETH Staking for all clients
description: HashKey Exchange launched ETH Staking for retail, professional and institutional clients at 4:00 PM HKT using an independent-node model with a 32 ETH minimum and a 20% service fee on generated rewards.
notes: The exact launch date is supported by HashKey Exchange's first-party launch announcement. Network rewards are not fixed returns and are subject to validator and Ethereum network conditions.
